data.composition_eval: N04-style emergent quartets on eval_202 (dev only until strong positive)
data.train: single transitions mined from train_101 parents via candidates_for_scene, stay:flip 1:1

event_head.output: stay/flip logit, updater y_{t+1}=y_t XOR u

frozen_encoder.note: net+feat_head frozen; only event head trains

gates.mainline: event>=0.90 AND dComp>=10pp AND FA<=+5pp AND multistep holds AND 3 seeds same direction

side_C.metric: D_AB f logit + hidden interaction norm, miss vs correct
